title: 3x3 Pickaxe
description: This plugin adds pickaxes that mine 3x3 blocks.
body:
## [Discord Support](https://discord.gg/Xw86rqWWcW)

**This plugin adds pickaxes that mine 3x3 blocks.**

### Commands:

To get a pickaxe like that, you need to have one selected. Then you have to enter this command.

```/tpickaxe```

#### If you have any ideas, improvements or feedback, feel free to tell us about them on our Discord server.
